display.purpose: Page/section headings, wordmark, car names on cards.

data.purpose: Every numeric value in the product — prices, ranges, percentages, warranty terms — always tabular.

body.purpose: Filter labels, copy, button text, table cells.

eyebrow.purpose: Mono uppercase section kickers paired with a display headline directly beneath.

shadows.name: recommended-glow
shadows.purpose: Border-adjacent glow marking the 'Recommended for you' card.

shadows.name: slider-fill-glow
shadows.purpose: Active gold segment of the dual-thumb range slider.

shadows.name: swatch-selected-ring
shadows.purpose: White spacer ring around a selected exterior-color swatch.

shadows.name: floating-surface
shadows.purpose: The fixed bottom compare bar — the one neutral (non-gold) shadow, meaning 'floating chrome' not 'important'.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Hover/focus color and opacity transitions across buttons, chips, borders.

motion.name: charge-sweep
motion.value: @keyframes charge-sweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%) } 60%,100% { transform: translateX(340%) } }, 1.1s ease-in-out infinite
motion.purpose: The gold bar sweeping inside the image-loading placeholder, read as 'charging' rather than a generic spinner.

motion.name: image-crossfade
motion.purpose: Car photo fades in once loaded instead of popping in.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most consequential action in a view (e.g. open comparison). Gold fill, dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent, #f5b700); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #17130f); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 6px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s ease, opacity 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #f5b700); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/reversible actions: Back, Reset, View details. Transparent with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #17130f); font-family: 'Inter Tight', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e2ded2); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, #17130f); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #f5b700); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggleable filter pill (country/feature). Unselected state, backed by a visually-hidden checkbox.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e2ded2); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink-muted, #6b6459); font-family: 'Inter Tight', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 4px 10px; transition: border-color 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-faint, #a39c8e); } .ds-chip-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); }

components.name: Filter Chip — Active
components.description: Selected state of the filter chip: gold wash fill, gold ember text, gold border.
components.css: .ds-chip--active { border-color: var(--color-accent, #f5b700); background: var(--color-accent-soft, #fbecb8); color: var(--color-accent-strong, #7a5400); }

components.name: Car Card
components.description: The canonical content card: image well, title/price row, gauge readout tile, feature chips, footer actions.
components.html:
Volvo EX30

335,000 DKK
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e2ded2); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-card-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-bg, #f4f3ef); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--color-ink, #17130f); margin: 0; } .ds-card-price { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; color: var(--color-ink, #17130f); margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-price span { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #6b6459); }

components.name: Budget Readout Input
components.description: The cockpit hero's budget field — a boxless mono readout with an underline focus treatment instead of a bordered box.
components.css: .ds-input-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-input-caption { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(244,243,239,0.45); } .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); padding-bottom: 4px; transition: border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-accent, #f5b700); } .ds-input { background: transparent; border: none; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.875rem; color: var(--color-bg, #f4f3ef); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; outline: none; min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); } .ds-input-suffix { font-size: 0.875rem; color: rgba(244,243,239,0.45); }

components.name: Charge Gauge
components.description: The system's signature component: a semicircle arc standing in for any progress bar — a single value from zero (battery retention) or a band between two values (range window).
components.html: <svg class="ds-gauge" viewBox="0 0 100 54"><path class="ds-gauge-track" d="M 8 50 A 40 40 0 0 1 92 50" /><path class="ds-gauge-fill" d="M 8 50 A 40 40 0 0 1 92 50" stroke-dasharray="0 40 60 126" /></svg>
components.css: .ds-gauge { width: 64px; height: auto; } .ds-gauge-track, .ds-gauge-fill { fill: none; stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-gauge-track { stroke: var(--color-border, #e2ded2); } .ds-gauge-fill { stroke: var(--color-accent, #f5b700); }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Feature on/off control in the comparison table. Built on a hidden checkbox inside a group-marked label; the track and thumb both react via :has(), not a sibling selector, because the thumb is nested two levels deep.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-switch-track { position: relative; height: 20px; width: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-border, #e2ded2); transition: background 0.18s ease; } .ds-switch:has(.ds-switch-input:checked) .ds-switch-track { background: var(--color-accent, #f5b700); } .ds-switch-thumb { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; height: 16px; width: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); transition: transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-switch:has(.ds-switch-input:checked) .ds-switch-thumb { transform: translateX(16px); }

narrative.overview:
Volt Index treats every screen the way an EV treats its dashboard: numbers you can trust, read at a glance, glowing exactly where they matter and nowhere else. The system is built around a single semicircle "charge gauge" — the one custom-drawn element in the whole app — reused everywhere a range or a percentage needs to be shown, so range windows and battery-retention figures read with the same authority a driver already trusts from the car itself. Everything around that signature stays quiet: a warm graphite-and-paper palette, one disciplined gold accent, and monospaced data set in tabular figures so prices and ranges never jitter as they update.

This is a decision tool for a first-time EV buyer, not a marketing surface, so the system was deliberately built to reject two defaults at once: the cream-paper-and-serif "AI generic" look, and the near-black-plus-neon-green "every EV app" look. Warm graphite ink stands in for near-black without going cold; voltage gold stands in for the neon accent without borrowing the green that every competing EV product already claims for itself — freeing green to mean exactly one thing in this system: a battery or resale rating that is actually good.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, used sparingly and only for brand/interactive moments — never for status.
A semicircle SVG gauge, not a flat progress bar, wherever a range or percentage appears.
Dark 'cockpit' ink bands mark the moments where the user is setting or reviewing the numbers that drive a decision — never used as a general content background.
All numeric data — prices, ranges, percentages, warranty terms — set in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Voltage gold is the system's only accent. It never shares a screen with a second brand hue, and it never carries status meaning (good/warning/bad) — those are always circuit-green / amber-warn / fault-red, kept visually and semantically separate from the brand color.

rules.name: The Text-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: Gold text on a light surface is always Gold Ember (#7a5400), never the base Voltage Gold (#f5b700) — the base value is a fill/glow color, not a text color; using it as type fails contrast.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every place a number can change (price as features toggle, range as filters move) uses tabular-nums so digits never shift width and cause layout jitter.

rules.name: The Glow-Means-Something Rule
rules.body: A shadow never appears just to lift a card off the page. Gold glow = this is the important/selected one; neutral shadow = this is physically floating (fixed/sticky chrome only).

dos: Do use the semicircle charge gauge, not a flat progress bar, for any range or percentage value — the repetition across cards/detail/comparison is what makes it a signature rather than a one-off.
Do keep Voltage Gold to brand/interactive moments only; if a color needs to mean 'good/warning/bad,' it's Circuit Green / Amber Warn / Fault Red, never gold.
Do set every number — prices, ranges, percentages, warranty terms — in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.

Do reserve dark cockpit-ink bands for parameter-setting/summary moments (the browse hero, the detail price strip, the comparison table header) — they mark 'these are the numbers that drive the decision,' not general content.
Do use Gold Ember (#7a5400), never base Voltage Gold, for gold text on a light surface.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue — the system deliberately spends its 'personality budget' on one color used with discipline, not several used timidly.
Don't use green anywhere except a genuinely good battery/resale rating — it is not a decorative or 'electric = green' color in this system.
Don't add a shadow to lift a card at rest; a shadow here always means either 'this is the important one' (gold glow) or 'this is floating chrome' (neutral shadow), never ambient depth.

Don't build a sliding/toggling nested element with Tailwind's peer-checked: — it only matches direct siblings. Use group + group-has-checked: for anything nested inside the sibling that changes state.
Don't let a custom focus treatment (like the budget input's underline glow) coexist with the browser's default :focus-visible outline — pick one visible indicator and suppress the other explicitly.
